test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All schools are colleges.

No college is a university.

Conclusions:

(I) Some colleges are not schools.

(II) Some schools may be universities.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db85923aae3376b8827fe50b768aaa69bb7b5b31a37855ed5b255daa06c6052c.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some colleges are not schools → False (As, All schools are colleges, then all school are colleges is possibility but not definite)

(II) Some schools may be universities → False (As, No college is a university and All schools are colleges then it cannot be possible)

Thus, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
